title: PHP2Shell: two unauthenticated PHP core RCEs, patched Oct 21 and now reported exploited in the wild (not in KEV)
why: watchTowr reports exploitation on its honeypot network on Oct 21, Cloudflare says early attacks are emerging, and Hadrian and Patchstack report active exploitation. Exploit code is circulating publicly. Neither CVE is in CISA KEV yet (watchTowr and SecurityOnline both checked).
action: Upgrade every internet-facing PHP to 8.5.12/8.4.27/8.3.36/8.2.35 (or a distro backport) and restart all PHP workers. Until then set session.upload_progress.enabled=0 and watch for php-fpm/httpd spawning shells.

title: LiteLLM 1.107.0 on PyPI/Docker compromised: credential stealer and hourly remote-code loader
why: JFrog, SafeDep, Socket, Aikido and OpenSourceMalware all confirm a malicious LiteLLM 1.107.0 published Oct 21, and GitHub issue BerriAI/litellm#47826 tracks it. This is a live supply-chain compromise with no CVE and no KEV entry. No vendor advisory from BerriAI was seen.
action: Search venvs, CI runners and containers for litellm==1.107.0 or cook.pth/a foreign sitecustomize.py. Rebuild affected hosts, pin litellm to 1.106.2 by digest, and rotate every credential those hosts could read.

title: Stolen UpdraftCentral keys used to push backdoor plugins to WordPress sites (TeamUpdraft breach)
why: TeamUpdraft confirmed a breach. Patchstack telemetry and Nethemba document backdoor plugin installs from Oct 18 15:32 to Oct 19 09:23 UTC (99 distinct plugin names). This is an exploited credential-abuse campaign with no CVE and nothing in KEV.
action: Update UpdraftPlus to 1.26.13/2.26.13+, delete every UpdraftCentral key, and audit for unknown plugins (including mu-plugins) and admin accounts created since Oct 18.

title: Cisco Expressway unauthenticated remote root command execution (database service, persistent cookies)
why: Cisco disclosed an unauthenticated root RCE on an edge collaboration product on Oct 21. It is not in KEV. No PoC or exploitation was found in one search.
action: Apply Cisco's fixed Expressway release and restrict clustering/database ports to cluster peers only.

title: Cisco Unified CM unauthenticated access control bypass
why: Cisco disclosed an unauthenticated remote access-control bypass on Oct 21. It is not in KEV. No PoC or exploitation was seen.
action: Apply Cisco's fixed Unified CM release and limit HTTP management access to trusted networks.
